description: image_transcribe catch-all for any `file` under uploads/ (predicate '~uploads/', a case-insensitive substring match). Listed by the tests whose upload must NOT be transcribed: a PDF with a text layer (ut_search_external_sites_ul1) and a lone .txt upload (ut_search_external_sites_ul2). A tool is registered only when a test lists a fixture for it, so without this one image_transcribe would be absent from those sessions and 'never calls image_transcribe' would hold whatever the agent did. It is a decoy: any call to it is the failure, and a validator fails the run on the call itself. It returns the same results page the upload holds, as production would for the PDF, so a wrong call changes nothing else about the run and the call stays the one thing that fails it.
